predecessor.title: Source-query encoder support tradeoff and fixed-frame obstruction
predecessor.body:
An invertible source encoder that logs the complete eight-coordinate query cannot make both endpoints sparse: its changed source fields and required target corrections together cover all **112 ports**. Each support also has at least eight ports. This is a scoped structural result for PR1862's clean-J interface, **not a new supplier or kappa**.

For Delta=G-I and H=(I-KR)Delta, the logger condition LG=R gives RDelta=(R-L)G. Its full row rank, together with nonzero K rows, proves the support cover. The statement also allows arbitrary finite address-linear encoders. Three explicit counterexamples show why the hypotheses are needed, and a valid three-port toy attains the cover.

For PR1862's fixed response Z, LZ=I makes the complete logger unique. It cannot commute with the unchanged line or specified output frames; two exact nonzero minors witness that obstruction for every positive tensor power. Changed/conjugated codes, paid transitions and carrying work through later native operations remain open. Endpoint support is not a universal native-child cost; the 112/120 rowwise figures in the report are conditional comparators only.

Validation at `4d9fa6016682c910be06e55b1c974d53052aee76`:

- [Dedicated Linux CI](https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38566908597) passes on Python 3.11 and 3.14.
- Local Python 3.11.15, 3.14.8 and a read-only source export run without Git/private dependencies; all six committed/local/Linux receipts are byte-identical.
- Source-derived scalar-prefix replay, 512-character census, two rational minors, four mutation controls and three missing-premise examples pass. No pending PR implementation is imported.

Only the new package and its dedicated workflow change. No full native supplier, global routing, hosting/precision or multiplication-theorem audit is claimed; other repository workflows are separate.

Credit aliromman's [PR1862](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1862) for the valid local encoder and stated interface, plus the pinned PR1042/PR1094 archive and retained E8/gauge44/native lineage. New proof and checker prepared for Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review or formal proof assistant.
